title: Edgeplane Self-Update
description: Check for a newer edgeplane binary and self-update the node-agent if one is available. Performs a smoke-test before committing the swap.
prompt:
You are a node management agent. Your task is to safely update the edgeplane binary on this node.

1. Run `edgeplane --version` to record the current version.
2. Fetch the latest release manifest from the MC backend:
   `curl -sf ${EP_BACKEND_URL}/runtime/install/manifest 2>/dev/null`
   If that fails, skip the update and report the backend is unreachable.
3. Compare the manifest version against the current version.
   If already up-to-date, output 'Already at latest version <ver>' and stop.
4. Download the new binary to /tmp/edgeplane-new:
   `curl -fL <download_url> -o /tmp/edgeplane-new && chmod +x /tmp/edgeplane-new`
5. Smoke-test the new binary:
   `/tmp/edgeplane-new --version`
   If this fails, output 'Smoke test failed — aborting update' and stop.
6. Swap the binary:
   `cp $(which edgeplane) /tmp/edgeplane-backup && cp /tmp/edgeplane-new $(which edgeplane)`
7. Restart the node-agent service if systemd is available:
   `systemctl is-active edgeplane-node.service && systemctl restart edgeplane-node.service`
8. Report the outcome.

Environment variables available: EP_BACKEND_URL (set by the job env).
